name_rule: Render foreign names with standard Xinhua transcription.
style_guide: Use a formal legal register. Translate faithfully and completely; never add, explain, summarise or complete text. Keep the source order and structure. Keep identifiers (ID, tax, serial and reference numbers, verification codes, URLs, emails, hashes) exactly as written. Keep dates and numbers as written in the source unless the job asks to localise them. Use formal written Chinese legal register. Notes: // 印章：... // , // 签名 // .

labels.repeated_notes_heading: 各页均有的印章和签名
